evidence_items.normalized_text: Must work from home due to childcare responsibilities

expected_constraints: must work from home due to childcare
acceptable_outputs: produces a 'constraint' dimension claim with high confidence given the single, clear, direct-statement evidence item
the claim's normalized_value preserves the hard nature of the constraint (not softened into a mere preference)
unacceptable_outputs: rephrases the constraint as a soft preference (e.g. 'would prefer remote work') that a later stage could reasonably override
omits the constraint from the emitted claims entirely
invents an unrelated constraint not present in the evidence
reviewer_notes: Stage 2 does not itself enforce CONSTRAINT.is_hard against recommendations (that's Stage 3's Scenario Ranker per docs/architecture/02_ERD.md's database rule 9) -- but Stage 2 must still faithfully preserve the hardness of the underlying evidence in the claim it emits, or the downstream enforcement has nothing correct to act on.

provenance.notes: Invented for Stage 2 golden-dataset coverage; no real candidate involved.
